rationale: The base station auto-updated to firmware 4.5, which now supports only protocol v3, while the garage motion sensor (SEN-M1) is still on firmware 1.1 speaking protocol v2 — hence E-305 and "connected_no_events." An OTA path to 1.4 exists but has failed twice with an image checksum mismatch at 61%, which per the fault-code reference requires escalation to FAE as a protocol conflict.

output.symptom_summary: Garage motion sensor (SEN-M1) stopped triggering events after base station auto-updated to firmware 4.5. Device shows connected_no_events with E-305 error, and OTA to firmware 1.4 fails twice with checksum mismatch at 61%.
output.suspected_root_cause: Protocol conflict: base station now only supports protocol v3, while sensor is on firmware 1.1 using protocol v2, and OTA upgrade to compatible firmware fails repeatedly.
key_abnormal_indicators: Base station firmware: 4.5 (supports only protocol v3)
OTA to 1.4 failed twice with image checksum mismatch at 61%
output.customer_reply: We've identified a firmware compatibility issue between your base station and garage sensor. Our engineering team will investigate and provide a fix. We'll follow up with you shortly. Thank you for your patience.

results.text: The peripheral firmware speaks a radio protocol the base station no longer supports, or vice versa. Frontline action: trigger OTA upgrade of the peripheral. If OTA is not available for the device or fails twice, escalate to FAE as protocol conflict.
